intro.sr: Kompletan tok zakazivanja: klijent se registruje, preko dugmeta „Zakažite termin“ bira uslugu, datum i vreme i potvrđuje, a zatim administrator potvrđuje i završava termin. Svaki klik je pokazan, na oba kraja. Snimljeno na telefonu (390x844).
intro.en: The full booking flow: the customer registers, picks a service, date and time via the “Zakažite termin” button and confirms, then an admin confirms and completes the appointment. Every click is shown, on both sides. Recorded on a phone (390x844).
